QuestInfo.name: [Weekly Quest] World Tree: Middle Tier - Eliminate the Swordsmen
QuestInfo.0: According to Alchetto, the demons are beyond reason. Give them an end worthy of their previous valor and purify the World Tree.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat either the dark demon swordsmen or the dark demon swordmasters from the middle tier of the World Tree and purify the World Tree.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the demons. The World Tree feels a little less dark.
